about.title: About
about.text:
Dr. Singhvi completed her residency in Internal Medicine from Wayne State University, USA, after which she completed her fellowship in Cardiology from the University of Connecticut, USA. She has also completed a fellowship in Advanced Heart Failure and Transplant Cardiology from Houston Methodist DeBakey Heart & Vascular Center, Houston, TX, which is one of the largest transplant centers in the USA. She worked as an Advanced Heart Failure and Transplant Cardiologist at Mount Sinai Hospital, New York, USA, and was recognized for her dedication to patient care by the Heart Failure Division there.
She is passionate about clinical research and has authored several peer-reviewed scientific publications and feels fortunate to serve on committees devoted to advanced heart disease and medical training. Her research interests include examining heart failure and post-heart transplant outcomes. She is determined to promote awareness of cardiovascular health, eliminate cardiovascular healthcare disparities, and improve the access of all patients to advanced heart failure therapies- including mechanical heart devices and cardiac transplantation.
She is currently working as a Consultant in the department of Adult Cardiology & Heart Transplantation at Narayana Institute of Cardiac Sciences, Bangalore, and has helped build the NH Heart Failure, LVAD, and Heart Transplant Care Center.

about.title: About
about.text:
Dr. Arunkumar Ullegaddi is a highly skilled and experienced Consultant Cardiologist at Narayana Institute of Cardiac Sciences, Bangalore. With a strong focus on interventional cardiology, Dr. Arunkumar has developed rare and advanced expertise in performing complex coronary angioplasties, a critical procedure for patients with severe coronary artery disease. His proficiency extends to the use of cutting-edge imaging technologies such as Intravascular Ultrasound (IVUS) and Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), which provide highly detailed visualizations of the coronary arteries, enabling precise diagnosis and optimal treatment planning.
Dr. Arunkumar is also adept at handling challenging cases involving significant coronary calcification, using advanced calcium modification techniques like Rotational Atherectomy (ROTA), Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL), and Orbital Atherectomy, ensuring safer and more effective stent deployment in heavily calcified vessels. His expertise covers a wide range of complex and high-risk procedures, including left main bifurcation interventions, chronic total occlusion (CTO) interventions, and specialized imaging-guided interventions using IVUS and OCT for precision treatment.
Through his meticulous approach, in-depth knowledge, and commitment to incorporating the latest advancements in cardiac care, Dr. Arunkumar Ullegaddi consistently delivers exceptional outcomes, even in the most challenging coronary interventions. His dedication to patient care and his advanced procedural skills have earned him recognition among both peers and patients, making him a trusted name in interventional cardiology at Narayana Institute of Cardiac Sciences."

about.title: About
about.text:
Dr. Bagirath Raghuraman is an esteemed Senior Consultant Cardiologist renowned for his leadership as the Program Director of Heart Transplant services. His illustrious academic journey commenced with an MBBS from J.J.M Medical College, Davangere, followed by MD in General Medicine from Kasturba Medical College, Manipal which was followed by DNB in General Medicine. He furthered his specialization in Cardiology, achieving a DM from Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiology.
Driven by a passion for excellence in cardiac care, Dr. Raghuraman pursued comprehensive training across esteemed international institutions. Noteworthy among his training includes specialized programs in advanced Heart Failure and Cardiac Transplantation at Papworth Hospital, Cambridge, UK. He honed his expertise in utilizing Cardiac Assist devices for heart failure management at The University of Minnesota, USA. His pursuit of excellence in Interventional Cardiology led him to The Rotenburg India Cardiovascular Clinic, Germany, where he gained invaluable insights. Additionally, he mastered the use of Intravascular Ultrasound, Rotablater techniques, and management of Chronic Total Occlusions in specialized programs in Japan.
Dr. Raghuraman's expertise encompasses various domains within Cardiology:
Interventional Cardiology: Proficiency in conducting complex coronary interventions and employing advanced intracoronary imaging techniques, ensuring precision and superior patient care.
Structural Heart Disease Interventions: Mastery in performing device closures for adult congenital heart diseases (ASD, VSD), TAVI (Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation), MitraClip procedures, and intricate interventions on mitral and tricuspid valves.
Cardiac Implantable Electronic Devices (CIED): Skilled in managing and implanting pacemakers, AICD (Automatic Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator), and CRT (Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy) devices for optimal patient outcomes.
Management of Pulmonary Embolism: Profound experience in managing acute and chronic pulmonary embolism, including specialized expertise in Balloon Pulmonary Angioplasty for CTEPH (Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Hypertension).
Advanced Heart Failure Management: Comprehensive skills in Mechanical Circulatory Support (MCS), encompassing both temporary and durable solutions such as LVAD (Left Ventricular Assist Device), Percutaneous ECMO, and expertise in Heart Transplant procedures.
Beyond his clinical expertise, Dr. Raghuraman has been recognized with numerous awards and accolades, including the Best Outgoing Student Gold Medal from J.J.M Medical College, Davangere, and the University Gold Medal at the 2nd Annual Convocation of Kuvempu University. His contributions in various conferences, as a principal investigator in clinical trials, and his presentations have earned him widespread acclaim.
His key procedures and unique skills include Temporary and Durable Mechanical Circulatory Support, Structural Heart Disease Interventions, Balloon Pulmonary Angioplasty, Cardiac Implantable Electronic Devices (CIED), and Complex Coronary Interventions with intracoronary imaging.
Dr. Bagirath Raghuraman's leadership as the Program Director of Heart Transplant services reflects his dedication to pioneering advancements in cardiac care and ensuring superior patient outcomes through innovation and comprehensive expertise He is also the member of Cardiology team at Narayana Hrudayalaya that performed India’s first permanent LV assist device (LVAD).
Post held in past
 

Zonal Clinical Director, Vice President and Head of Department of Cardiology, Chinmaya Narayana Superspeciality Centre, Bangalore.
Lecturer in Cardiology, Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiology, Bangalore.
Registrar in Cardiology, Manipal Hospital, Bangalore.

about.text: Dr. Abhinandan S Punit has undergone extensive training in Traumatology and Orthopedics with esteemed national and international institutions. He completed his Master of Surgery in Orthopedics from Kasturba Medical College in 2011 and was awarded DNB Orthopedics in 2012 from the National Board of Examinations. Dr. Punit has received advanced surgical training in hip, knee, and shoulder surgeries from prestigious hospitals in the United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia for nearly five years. He holds several notable international degrees. With a distinguished academic background, Dr. Punit has numerous national and international papers, research, and conference presentations to his credit. His areas of special interest include navigated and robotic hip and knee replacement, minimally invasive hip replacement (anterior approach), shoulder surgeries, and sports medicine, including hip arthroscopy. He has performed over 6000 surgeries and has worked with both amateur and elite athletes, including those from the Sports Authority of India, Bangalore. Currently he is working at Narayana Health City, Bengaluru, as a Clinical Lead for robotic joint replacement and arthroplasty.

about.text: Dr. Gopal Krishna Dash passed MBBS from Sambalpur Medical University, Odisha, India in 2001 and served the government of Orissa for 2 years and completed his post graduation in general medicine from SCB Medical College, Cuttack, Odisha, India in the year of 2007. He then worked in Institute of Human Behavior and Allied sciences, Delhi for a period of 6 months as a senior resident in the department of Neurology and joined the prestigious institute of national importance under government of India, Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology in 2008 as a senior resident (DM Neurology) in the department of Neurology. After successfully completing the same, he underwent advanced training in the comprehensive epilepsy care centre of the same institute for one year. During his DM training, he gained a vast experience in treating various complex neurological disorders which include both acute and chronic cases. During the postdoctoral fellowship period, he gained further experience in reporting scalp EEG, prolonged Video-EEG, intracranial monitoring and presurgical evaluation of patients with medically refractory epilepsy. Dr Dash continued his academic carrier in the same institute as a consultant after obtaining his advanced training.He is an expert in the field of epileptology with vast experience in treating various complex and difficult to manage patients with epilepsy. In addition, he is also an expert in treating various sleep disorders. Currently, he works as a consultant neurologist, epileptologist and sleep medicine specialist in the same institute. His current activities include teaching DM neurology residents, post-doctoral fellows in the division of epilepsy and he supervises the sleep lab. Of late for the past one month, Dr Dash works as an epilepsy specialist in a JCI accredited hospital in India, Hyderabad.

about.title: About
about.text: Dr. Naveen B S is a head and neck oncology specialist with expertise in managing cancers of the oral cavity, throat, thyroid, and related structures. He is skilled in complex oncologic surgeries, including organ-preserving and reconstructive procedures. With a patient-focused approach, he emphasizes early diagnosis, multidisciplinary care, and precise surgical treatment to improve outcomes and quality of life.

about.title: About
about.text: Dr. Nidhi Tandon is a highly accomplished medical oncologist, renowned for her expertise in advanced cancer treatments like targeted therapy and immunotherapy. After receiving her oncology training from two of the world's most prestigious institutions, Tata Memorial Hospital in India and the Mayo Clinic in the United States, she's practising as a clinical and academic lead of medical oncology and advisor to oncology collegium at Narayana Health City, Bengaluru. Apart from authoring more than 50 research articles in various national and international journals, she is also the recipient of prestigious awards like the Conquer Cancer Merit award from American Society of Clinical Oncology, SIOP Scholarship from International Society of Paediatric Oncology and Best Thesis Award at Indian Oncology Cooperative Network. She is also a mentor and guide to DNB Oncology students. Her clinical acumen, coupled with a passion for innovation, positions her as a leading figure in the evolving landscape of oncology.

items.text: Leadership and Recognition:
Recognized for her outstanding contributions in oncology, Dr. Tandon has received prestigious awards and scholarships.
Conquer Cancer Merit Award for a poster presentation at the ASCO annual meeting in 2016.
SIOP Scholarship for a poster presentation at the 46th Congress of the International Society of Pediatric Oncology in 2014.
Best thesis award at the 30th Annual Meeting of the Indian Oncology Cooperative Network in 2014.
Travel Scholarship for ACORD Workshop on Cancer Clinical Research Methods in 2012.
Editorial Contributions:
Dr. Tandon has made significant contributions to the field of oncology literature.
Multiple presentations at various international conferences.
Authored various original articles, review articles, editorials, and book chapters in peer-reviewed journals and international books.
Professional Memberships & Certifications:
Active member of prestigious medical associations.
Association of Physicians of India.
Indian Society of Medical and Pediatric Oncology.
